If you are looking for Farm to Table Beef that you can trust, look no further! We started this beef company from our family ranch in Springtown, TX with the intention of providing high quality Texas beef that you can trust! 

If you are local to Springtown, TX or the Parker County area we would love to meet you in person at our retail office located at 1705 N FM 51, Springtown, TX 76082.

Parker County Beef Company FAQs

Get answers to your most common questions!

What is the history and background of your ranch?

The Burtnetts have been raising cattle for over 100 years in Springtown, TX. In 2023, we expanded to offer our high-quality beef nationwide.

Where is your ranch located?

Our headquarters is in Springtown, TX, with operations across Wise and Parker Counties. Visit us at 1705 N FM 51, Springtown, TX, 76082.

What types of beef products do you offer?

We provide a range of products, including individual cuts like ground beef, steaks, roasts, ribs, organs, bones, and curated boxes.

What makes your beef different from grocery store beef?

Our transparent process, visible on social media, showcases the journey from pasture to plate.

Is your beef grass-fed, grain-finished, or both?

Our cattle are grass-fed and grain-finished for over 150 days for quality marbling.

What is the diet of your cattle?

Initially grass-fed, our cattle later consume free-choice hay and grain before processing.

What breed(s) of cattle do you raise?

Primarily Black Angus, with some legacy Hereford and Charolais bulls being phased out.

Where is your beef processed?

Processed at a local USDA processor, we ensure fresh inventory rotation.

Are your products USDA certified?

Our beef is processed under USDA inspection for quality and health standards.

How long are your beef products aged?

Our products are wet-aged for 14 days prior to packaging.

What shipping options, costs, and lead times do you offer?

We ship nationwide every Monday via UPS on dry ice, usually within 4 days.

How is the beef packaged and shipped?

Our beef is individually wrapped, labeled, vacuum sealed, with ground beef in 1lb packages.

What is your policy on cancellations, returns, or exchanges?

We offer replacements for shipping issues while resolving the matter with UPS.

Do you offer gift purchases or E-Gift cards?

Yes, both are available, with E-Gift cards accessible on our website.

How can I place an order and what payment methods are accepted?

Place orders online, via social media, or by calling/texting 817-404-7405. We accept credit/debit cards and cash.

Do you offer any discounts, subscriptions, or loyalty programs?

Our Subscribe and Save program provides a 5% discount and a free cut of beef with each order.

How should your beef be stored and cooked for optimal quality?

Store frozen and thaw in the refrigerator for best quality.

How do you ensure the quality and safety of your products?

We adhere to strict standards for storage and transport, ensuring freshness and safety.

What is your approach to sustainability and environmental stewardship?

We consider impacts on people, land, animals, and the environment in every decision.

How can customers contact you for support or inquiries?

Call or text us at 817-404-7405 or you can email us at orders@parkercountybeefcompany.com

Our Story

Welcome to Parker County Beef Company, a family owned and operated beef company based in Springtown, Texas. Our family, the Burtnetts, have been ranching for four generations in North Texas, and we take great pride in providing our customers with the highest quality beef while supporting our local community.

As owners and operators of the Parker County Beef Company, we are involved in every aspect of the business, from caring for our cattle to ensuring that each cut of beef meets our high standards for taste, tenderness, and quality. We believe that the best beef comes from happy and healthy cows, and we work hard to maintain the highest standards of animal welfare.

Our beef is grass-fed and finished with locally sourced grains, ensuring that each cut is not only delicious but also healthy. We specialize in selling whole and half beef directly to consumers, which means that you get to enjoy the full range of cuts and flavors that come from a single animal. By cutting out the middleman and selling directly to our customers, we are able to offer high-quality beef at affordable prices.

At Parker County Beef Company, we are committed to supporting our local community. We believe in sustainable and ethical farming practices, and we work closely with local suppliers to ensure that our beef is always fresh and locally sourced.

We are proud to be a part of the Springtown community, and as the Burtnett family, we are dedicated to providing our customers with the best beef possible. Whether you're a barbecue enthusiast, a home cook, or just looking for high-quality meat for your family, we are confident that you will love our beef. Thank you for choosing Parker County Beef Company!

Our half beef costs $6.50/lb on the hanging weight. Once we get that final number from our processor, you will know your final order total. 
What is hanging weight? 
Hanging weight is the weight of your beef after all of the non edible parts have been removed. This weight can often be referred to as rail weight. 
How much hanging weight can I expect from my beef? 
Hanging weight is usually about 60% of the live weight of the animal. For reference our last few hanging weights have varied from 780 to 1005 pounds. 
What is required to get started on my half beef? 
If you are ready to get started click our links on this page to begin the process. Please find 20 mins that works with you schedule that we can thoroughly go through our Welcome to the Ranch process. On this call we will answer any questions you have about our ranch, our beef, and how we do things. Your deposit will also be taken on this call so that as soon as we are finished we can get the process started. 
During the call we will go through your cut sheet in detail. This will involve choosing your steaks, roasts, ribs, ground beef, etc. Our goal at the end of the call is that the next time you hear from us your completely custom half beef will be ready for pickup. 
How much is the deposit on a half beef? 
Our deposit is $2500 and is due during our Welcome to the Ranch Call. Once we have your final hanging weight we will contact you to adjust your payment either way. Most times you will have a small balance left to pay. In the event that your order total is less than $2500 we will promptly refund you the difference. 
How much beef can I expect from a half beef?
The general rule of thumb is you can expect about 60-65% of your hanging weigh back in box weight beef. This number varies based on how you fill out your cut sheet. Bone in cuts will result in a higher total weight received back. No matter how you fill out your cut sheet, you are not "losing" any beef during the process you are simply re allocating it.

Versatility in Cooking: Ideal for a variety of dishes, from classic burgers and meatballs to gourmet tacos and lasagna. Our ground beef is a staple for any kitchen.
Direct from Ranch to Kitchen: By buying directly from our ranch, you're guaranteed a product that's traceable, sustainable, and supports local farming.
